Shiv Sena, Maratha Activist Seek Probe into Rs 500 Cr Audio Clip

Shiv Sena and Maratha reservation activist Manoj Jarange have demanded a forensic audit and a Special Investigation Team (SIT) probe into a viral audio clip. The clip allegedly discusses a payment of Rs 500 crore to end the Maratha agitation. The demands follow the emergence of the audio clip.
